hematology-h15.title: 风湿诊断语言与治疗角色
hematology-h15.first_pass_focus: 从综合征和器官组合进入风湿病例，再给抗体/炎症指标/药物分配正确角色。
hematology-h15.stop_line: 不提前复制H16–H19疾病主体；SSc/肌炎/痛风仅overview识别。
hematology-h15.recall_spine: 从主诉组成综合征 → 风湿证据四层 → 治疗四层 → bounded recognition models → 皮肤/器官线索与最终路由

c-h15-lg01.label: 从主诉组成综合征，再进疾病家族
c-h15-lg01.goal: use joint axis + systemic-organ axis + time axis to place a case into connective-tissue, spondyloarthritis, degenerative, crystal/metabolic or infection-related families before serology.
c-h15-lg01.closure: given a joint/systemic complaint, describe the syndrome and disease-family direction without naming a disease from one antibody or one joint.
c-h15-lg01.continuity_rationale: identity, five families and three-axis entry are one routing problem.

c-h15-lg02.label: 风湿证据四层：筛查、特异、活动、器官损害
c-h15-lg02.goal: assign ANA/RF, disease-specific antibodies, complement/ESR/CRP and organ tests to the question each can answer.
c-h15-lg02.closure: for a positive ANA/RF or inflammatory marker, state what it supports, what it cannot prove and which organ-specific evidence must be added before changing the disease model.
c-h15-lg02.continuity_rationale: these KPs are one evidence-role hierarchy; marker names are subordinate to role.

c-h15-lg03.label: 治疗四层：症状快不等于病程被控制
c-h15-lg03.goal: distinguish NSAID symptom relief, GC rapid suppression/bridge, conventional DMARD disease control and targeted/biologic disease control by role and speed.
c-h15-lg03.closure: given active symptoms and organ severity, choose the required treatment *role* and explain why quick symptomatic improvement cannot substitute for disease-modifying control.
c-h15-lg03.continuity_rationale: KP07 provides the map; KP08–10 calibrate each role and speed.

c-h15-lg04.label: 三个 bounded recognition models：认出来，但不扩成新课程
c-h15-lg04.goal: recognize the Current Source high-signal entries for systemic sclerosis, inflammatory myopathy/dermatomyositis and gout, then stop at the explicit overview boundary.
c-h15-lg04.closure: from a high-signal clue set (Raynaud/finger/ILD, Gottron/heliotrope/Jo-1, nocturnal first-MTP/tophus), route to the correct overview identity and state what full model is **not** owned here.
c-h15-lg04.continuity_rationale: these three are intentionally grouped as a “bounded recognition gate”: the shared learner question is whether an overview-level pattern is recognized without manufacturing three unsupported full subcourses.

c-h15-lg05.label: 皮肤 / 器官线索与最终风湿路由
c-h15-lg05.goal: treat skin/mucosal clues as routing evidence only, then send the case to H16–H19 using organ combination + evidence role + activity/damage layer.
c-h15-lg05.closure: solve a fresh multi-system rheumatology entry case and explain why the visible skin/antibody clue is insufficient by itself.
c-h15-lg05.continuity_rationale: KP14 supplies cross-disease visible clues; KP15 turns them into the Block exit algorithm.

hematology-h16.title: 系统性红斑狼疮与抗磷脂综合征
hematology-h16.first_pass_focus: 把SLE拆成免疫复合物、抗细胞和APS三支，再用抗体角色和器官组合完成判断。
hematology-h16.stop_line: 狼疮肾/产科APS/长期抗凝完整路径归外部owner或Source gap。
hematology-h16.recall_spine: 三条损伤支路 → SLE证据角色 → APS → 病理落点 → 临床多器官模型 → 治疗/危象/危险分流

c-h16-lg01.label: 三条损伤支路：免疫复合物、抗细胞、APS
c-h16-lg01.goal: establish SLE as a three-branch model before any antibody list: immune-complex multi-organ injury, direct anti-cell cytopenia and antiphospholipid thrombosis.
c-h16-lg01.closure: from an SLE manifestation, name which branch best explains it and why the same disease can express more than one immune-injury mechanism.
c-h16-lg01.continuity_rationale: singleton mother model; it must precede serology to prevent marker-first learning.

c-h16-lg02.label: SLE证据角色：筛查、特异、活动、器官关联
c-h16-lg02.goal: place ANA, dsDNA, Sm, ENA, anti-cell antibodies, complement/inflammation and organ evidence into explicit roles rather than one “SLE antibody” bucket.
c-h16-lg02.closure: given a panel, identify which result screens, which is most specific, which tracks activity/kidney, which explains a blood/organ manifestation and which results do not track activity.
c-h16-lg02.continuity_rationale: these six KPs answer one evidence-role question. H16-SC01 stays visible: the conflicting historical question answer is not silently corrected.

c-h16-lg03.label: APS：实验室名字反直觉，但临床主轴是血栓
c-h16-lg03.goal: bind LA/aCL/anti-β2GPI to arterial/venous thrombosis, recurrent pregnancy loss and thrombocytopenia while rejecting the “anticoagulant name = bleeding disorder” shortcut.
c-h16-lg03.closure: from thrombosis/pregnancy/platelet evidence, identify the APS branch and state the current Source boundary around formal criteria, long-term anticoagulation and obstetric management.
c-h16-lg03.continuity_rationale: antibody identity and clinical phenotype are one APS submodel.

c-h16-lg04.label: 病理落点：小体/细胞、肾、皮肤、心脾血管
c-h16-lg04.goal: connect immune injury to lupus body/cell, wire-loop kidney, lupus band/skin and Libman-Sacks/onion-skin spleen/fibrinoid vascular damage.
c-h16-lg04.closure: from a pathology image/description, identify the organ/pathologic anchor and reconnect it to the correct upstream SLE branch without expanding full nephrology/cardiology.
c-h16-lg04.continuity_rationale: these are the major pathology anchors that make the abstract immune model visible.

c-h16-lg05.label: 临床多器官模型：皮黏—浆膜/关节—血液—肾/神经
c-h16-lg05.goal: reconstruct the SLE clinical combination, distinguish Jaccoud from RA erosive disease, separate cytopenia mechanisms and use renal/neuro clues as high-risk exits.
c-h16-lg05.closure: from a multi-organ vignette, build the organ combination first, then use the serologic evidence stack to close the diagnosis instead of using ANA alone.
c-h16-lg05.continuity_rationale: five KPs form the clinical phenotype and diagnostic order.

c-h16-lg06.label: 治疗 / 危象 / SLE-vs-APS danger routing
c-h16-lg06.goal: distinguish background control, immunosuppressive disease treatment, lupus crisis escalation and APS thrombotic danger.
c-h16-lg06.closure: identify whether the current threat is inflammatory organ damage/crisis or thrombosis/APS and choose the Source-supported treatment role without importing external dosing/criteria.
c-h16-lg06.continuity_rationale: treatment only makes sense after the current danger branch is named.

hematology-h17.title: 类风湿关节炎
hematology-h17.first_pass_focus: 从滑膜炎→血管翳→侵蚀建立RA病程，再接临床/影像/证据和DMARD治疗逻辑。
hematology-h17.stop_line: 骨科重建和外部生物制剂指南不在H17。
hematology-h17.recall_spine: 滑膜→血管翳→侵蚀 → 临床关节+关节外 → RF/ACPA+影像 → 治疗 → 两套诊断Source+SLE比较

c-h17-lg01.label: 滑膜 → 血管翳 → 侵蚀：RA为什么必须早控制病程
c-h17-lg01.goal: connect CD4-centered immune background to proliferative synovitis, pannus, cartilage/bone destruction and rheumatoid nodule; contrast the resulting structural disease with rheumatic arthritis.
c-h17-lg01.closure: explain the irreversible structure-damage chain and use it to distinguish RA from transient/nonerosive inflammatory arthritis.
c-h17-lg01.continuity_rationale: these five KPs are the causal/pathologic foundation; treatment logic later depends on it.

c-h17-lg02.label: 临床关节 + 关节外模式：结构损害已经如何表现
c-h17-lg02.goal: integrate morning stiffness, symmetric wrist/MCP/PIP pattern, irreversible deformities, extra-articular disease, Felty and Caplan.
c-h17-lg02.closure: from a clinical pattern, distinguish active inflammatory symptoms, late structural damage and special systemic syndromes; preserve the 30-min vs historical 1-hour morning-stiffness Source conflict.
c-h17-lg02.continuity_rationale: these KPs answer the phenotype question after the pannus mechanism is established.

c-h17-lg03.label: 证据：RF / ACPA +影像；证据角色不等于病名
c-h17-lg03.goal: distinguish RF from anti-CCP/ACPA, demote the broad immunoglobulin pairing list to MI-D, and connect MRI early soft-tissue evidence to the X-ray structural progression.
c-h17-lg03.closure: decide what supports early RA, what is nonspecific, what images early inflammation versus accumulated damage and why seronegative RA remains possible.
c-h17-lg03.continuity_rationale: KP13 stays inside the evidence group only as a low-priority Source pairing Safety Net; it does not become RA ontology.

c-h17-lg04.label: 治疗：症状控制 + DMARD病程控制
c-h17-lg04.goal: connect irreversible pannus damage to the need for early DMARDs while keeping NSAID/GC rapid symptom/bridge roles and MTX/targeted/biologic escalation distinct.
c-h17-lg04.closure: choose the Source-supported treatment role from disease activity/organ involvement and explain why pain relief alone cannot protect joint structure.
c-h17-lg04.continuity_rationale: these three KPs are one therapy architecture, not a drug list.

c-h17-lg05.label: 两套诊断 Source + SLE comparison
c-h17-lg05.goal: preserve the internal-medicine four-dimensional diagnostic frame and historical surgery 4/7 standard as two Source contexts, then compare RA vs SLE on erosion, kidney, platelets, complement and treatment.
c-h17-lg05.closure: answer a diagnostic-standard question according to its Source context and distinguish RA from SLE without synthesizing a fake unified criterion set.
c-h17-lg05.continuity_rationale: diagnosis-context management and high-value SLE comparison are the Block exit/falsification layer.

hematology-h18.title: 原发性干燥综合征
hematology-h18.first_pass_focus: 从外分泌腺免疫浸润解释口眼干，再接腺外受累、直接证据和NHL风险。
hematology-h18.stop_line: 不扩泛化sicca百科；外部肾/淋巴瘤处理回owner。
hematology-h18.recall_spine: 腺体浸润→口眼分泌失败 → 系统病输出 → SSA/SSB+腺体病理/功能 → 治疗分流 → 皮肤线索边界

c-h18-lg01.label: 腺体浸润 → 口眼分泌失败
c-h18-lg01.goal: connect autoimmune exocrine-gland infiltration to salivary/lacrimal failure and the characteristic oral/ocular phenotype.
c-h18-lg01.closure: distinguish true glandular secretion failure from simple thirst/dehydration and explain why caries/parotid disease follow loss of saliva function.
c-h18-lg01.continuity_rationale: identity, mechanism, mouth and eye are one exocrine-failure model.

c-h18-lg02.label: 系统病输出：关节、肾小管、皮血、淋巴瘤风险
c-h18-lg02.goal: prove Sjögren is systemic by linking nonerosive joints, RTA/low-K/alkaline urine, purpura/cytopenia and persistent parotid/NHL-MALT warning signs.
c-h18-lg02.closure: from an extra-gland manifestation, route to the correct organ owner and distinguish Sjögren from RA/SLE/dehydration or ordinary parotid swelling.
c-h18-lg02.continuity_rationale: these are the major extra-gland outputs and downstream danger signal.

c-h18-lg03.label: 证据：SSA/SSB + 腺体病理 / 功能
c-h18-lg03.goal: combine SSA/SSB with lip-gland biopsy and salivary/tear functional tests; preserve the Source reading boundary around “highest specificity”.
c-h18-lg03.closure: state what serology supports, why lip-gland biopsy is the current gold-standard evidence and why one antibody cannot replace glandular pathology/function.
c-h18-lg03.continuity_rationale: serology and direct gland evidence answer complementary questions.

c-h18-lg04.label: 治疗按“局部分泌失败 vs 系统器官炎症”分流
c-h18-lg04.goal: separate secretagogue/supportive treatment from GC/immunosuppression when internal organs are involved.
c-h18-lg04.closure: classify treatment role from organ involvement without expanding external biologic/dose algorithms.

c-h18-lg05.label: 皮肤线索只是入口，不是疾病身份证
c-h18-lg05.goal: use the Source skin-lesion comparison as a cross-disease routing Safety Net while refusing to diagnose from morphology alone.
c-h18-lg05.closure: from a skin clue, name the likely owner(s) to reopen and the systemic evidence still required.
c-h18-lg05.continuity_rationale: singleton cross-System recognition Safety Net; mixing it with treatment would create an incoherent group.

hematology-h19.title: 系统性血管炎与贝赫切特病
hematology-h19.first_pass_focus: 先按血管口径+器官组合定位血管炎，再用ANCA/病理/造影校正，并建立Behçet变口径模型。
hematology-h19.stop_line: 不扩完整血管炎指南；器官专科处理回A/D等owner。
hematology-h19.recall_spine: 共同血管模型+口径 → ANCA/AECA/biopsy/angiography → MPA/pauci-immune+renal比较 → Behçet clinical identity → scoring boundary+treatment

c-h19-lg01.label: 共同血管模型 + 口径分类
c-h19-lg01.goal: connect vessel-wall inflammation to stenosis/occlusion/thrombosis/ischemia versus wall destruction/hemorrhage/aneurysm, then classify by large/medium/small/variable caliber.
c-h19-lg01.closure: from an organ event, infer the likely vessel-caliber problem before using serology.
c-h19-lg01.continuity_rationale: mechanism and caliber are the universal coordinate system for the Block.

c-h19-lg02.label: 证据角色：ANCA / AECA / biopsy / angiography
c-h19-lg02.goal: separate IIF c/p patterns from PR3/MPO targets, use disease pairings as support, demote nonspecific AECA, and distinguish biopsy diagnosis from large/medium-vessel angiographic range mapping.
c-h19-lg02.closure: choose the correct evidence modality for a suspected vasculitis and state why ANCA or a negative segmental biopsy cannot independently close/exclude every case.
c-h19-lg02.continuity_rationale: all five KPs answer “what evidence is appropriate for what vessel problem?”

c-h19-lg03.label: MPA / pauci-immune organ model + renal cross-rheum comparison
c-h19-lg03.goal: integrate glomerular, pulmonary, skin/mucosal and peripheral-nerve MPA patterns, Current treatment role and the crucial distinction between type-III RPGN and type-III hypersensitivity; compare renal localization across SLE/Sjögren/MPA/RA/Behçet.
c-h19-lg03.closure: solve a pulmonary-renal vignette, state why pauci-immune ANCA disease is not immune-complex hypersensitivity, and route full renal/pulmonary models back to their owners.
c-h19-lg03.continuity_rationale: KP17 belongs here because its value is to localize MPA renal disease against the other rheumatic models.

c-h19-lg04.label: Behçet clinical identity: variable-caliber vessel + oral/genital/eye/skin/system clues
c-h19-lg04.goal: connect variable-caliber arterial/venous vasculitis to recurrent painful oral/genital ulcers, eye disease, skin/thrombophlebitis, gut/joint and pathergy clues.
c-h19-lg04.closure: recognize Behçet from the *combination*, distinguish painful oral ulcers from SLE’s usually painless ulcers and avoid reducing the disease to a small-vessel category.
c-h19-lg04.continuity_rationale: vascular identity and clinical combination are one disease model.

c-h19-lg05.label: Behçet scoring boundary + treatment routing
c-h19-lg05.goal: preserve only the three Source-secure 2-point items and route therapy by internal-organ/eye vs oral ulcer vs recurrent mucocutaneous phenotype.
c-h19-lg05.closure: answer only the score precision the original Source safely supports, identify the appropriate treatment role and explicitly leave unverified score rows/modern biologics outside Current.
c-h19-lg05.continuity_rationale: scoring and treatment are the final decision layer; H19-SR01 remains open rather than being filled from memory.
